meta_note: All methods are exposed on the FinanceService gRPC server. Auth is enforced per-method via RpcAuthGuard; the authenticated user is injected via @RpcUser().

rpc_errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Missing or invalid JWT in gRPC metadata
rpc_errors.NOT_FOUND: Requested resource does not belong to the user
rpc_errors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Validation failed on the request payload

createTransaction.description: Create a new transaction for the authenticated user. Amount is a string in the proto for precision; type and source are proto enum integers.

input.source: TransactionSource enum int — MANUAL=0, BANK=1, RECURRING=2, OCR=3, SPLIT=4
input.category_slug: string — resolved to category for this user or system
input.source_data: string (optional) — JSON string merged into row

throws.ALREADY_EXISTS: Unique constraint violation (e.g. duplicate bank transaction)

batchCreateTransactions.description: Bulk-create transactions for the authenticated user. Used by the account sync pipeline after AI classification.

input.transactions: array of bank-import rows — each item uses categoryId (UUID), optional bankTransactionId for idempotency

output.skipped: int32 — rows skipped as duplicates or unchanged

throws.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Unknown type/source enum on any item

getTransactions.description: Return a paginated, filtered list of transactions for the authenticated user.

throws.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Unknown type or source enum in filter arrays

getTransaction.description: Return a single transaction by ID scoped to the authenticated user.

throws.NOT_FOUND: Transaction not found or not owned by user

updateTransaction.description: Update a transaction by ID. When a BANK transaction's category is changed and it was AI-classified, a correction feedback job is enqueued to the AI service via BullMQ.

throws.NOT_FOUND: Transaction not found, not owned by user, or category_slug does not resolve
throws.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Unknown type enum or invalid payload

deleteTransaction.description: Delete a transaction by ID scoped to the authenticated user.

throws.NOT_FOUND: Transaction not found or not owned by user

getTransactionSummary.description: Dashboard aggregates: net balance, current calendar month income/expense/net from UserBalance (when monthYear matches), balanceChangePct vs latest MonthlyBalanceSnapshot or stale balance fallback, Mon–Sun ISO week daily expenses, 84-day expense heatmap, and monthly income/expense series (snapshots plus live current month).

output.monthlyIncome: string — decimal, current month (0 if balance row is stale month)
output.balanceChangePct: double — percent change vs reference prior month net
output.weeklySpending: array DailySpending — 7 days Mon–Sun this ISO week
output.spendingHeatmap: array DailySpending — 84 consecutive days, EXPENSE totals, zero-filled
output.monthlySeries: array MonthlyFinancials — up to 12 archived months oldest→newest plus current month appended
